name: Avatar
description: A circular image element with a fallback for representing a user. Built on @radix-ui/react-avatar. The root is a 40x40px rounded-full container. AvatarImage fills it with aspect-square sizing, and AvatarFallback displays initials or an icon when the image fails to load.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes applied to the avatar root container.

subComponents.name: AvatarImage
subComponents.description: The img element displayed inside the avatar. Fills the container with aspect-square sizing. Falls back to AvatarFallback if the image fails to load.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible alt text for the image.

subComponents.name: AvatarFallback
subComponents.description: The fallback content shown while the image is loading or if it fails. Displayed as centered content on a bg-primary rounded-full background with text-primary-foreground color.

props.name: delayMs
props.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing the fallback to avoid flashing for fast-loading images.

props.name: children
props.description: Fallback content, typically initials or an icon.

accessibility.role: The Avatar renders as a span container. The AvatarImage renders as an img element with alt text support.
accessibility.keyboard: Not interactive by default. If wrapped in a button or link, standard keyboard interactions apply.
accessibility.aria: Provide meaningful alt text on AvatarImage for screen readers. If the avatar is purely decorative, use alt=''.
accessibility.notes: AvatarFallback content should provide equivalent meaning to the image (e.g., user initials).
